name_reason: Compliant and descriptive. fd2_ prefix (game function); 'chapter_event_handler' = role; '0d' is the per-event handler-table dispatch index 0x0D (table @ 0x51B91, slot at 0x51BC5 holds 0x34E90) -- a meaningful domain ID, not an address residue (function lives at 0x34E90, not 0x...0d); 'ch15' = chapter 15 (valid 1-30 domain ID); 'dialog_with_state' = category (shows a dialog page then writes combat AI state). Name matches verified behaviour.
purpose: Chapter 15 turn-4 turn-event handler (dispatch idx 0x0D): show dialog page 6, then arm AI mode 3 for the boss/panther-target group (runtime-char slots 0x40..0x49) and disarm the per-event AI/dialog control flag for the mid-tier band (slots 0x23..0x31).
logic_summary: Straight-line, no-branch, no-RNG. (1) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=6, fixed dialog geometry 0xA0000/0x140/0xCD/0x4C/0x4A/0x13/1); its uint32 return is discarded. (2) for i in [0x40,0x49]: combat_aux_block[0xE] = 0 (preset AI param byte +0xE to 0 across the 10-char boss group). (3) fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x40,0x49,3): set low nibble of combat_aux_block[0xD] (abs runtime_char off 0x34) = 3 for slots 0x40..0x49 -> AI mode 3. (4) fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x23,0x31,0): clear that low nibble across slots 0x23..0x31 (15 chars). combat_aux_block is a per-char combat scratch sub-block, distinct from the strategy-guide's runtime_char +0xD/+0xE (action-state/team).
